“There are many areas where Ukraine and Hungary can work together and strengthen one another. Energy, bilateral trade, and humanitarian support — we discussed all of these today,” President Zelenskyy said following his meeting with Hungarian Prime Minister Péter Magyar. The discussions included gas and diesel supplies to Ukraine, as well as expanding Hungarian companies’ use of Ukrainian gas storage facilities. The two sides also discussed joint infrastructure projects, including the reconstruction of existing border crossings, the construction of new ones, and the launch of direct train services along new routes between the countries. Humanitarian demining and Hungary’s increased participation in the relevant coalition were also on the agenda. “We reached concrete agreements on all these issues and instructed our teams to work at their respective levels to ensure their swift implementation,” Zelenskyy said.

Visioner BREAKING | 🇮🇷 🇺🇸 ‼️ ‼️ Iran’s military claims to have shot down two American drones over the Strait of Hormuz, including a US Air Force MQ-9A Reaper and a LUCAS one-way attack drone. According to the Iranian Army, the MQ-9A Reaper was intercepted over the eastern Strait of Hormuz, while the LUCAS drone was brought down over the western section of the strategic waterway. Iranian sources also released an image reportedly showing debris from the intercepted LUCAS drone. The circumstances of the interceptions and the loss of either aircraft have not been independently verified by US authorities. The reported interceptions highlight the growing risks to American unmanned aircraft operating near Iranian-controlled waters. The MQ-9A Reaper is a valuable surveillance and strike platform, while LUCAS represents a lower-cost approach to long-range drone operations. The loss of either system could influence how US forces conduct reconnaissance and strikes around the Strait of Hormuz, where further military incidents could threaten regional security and commercial shipping.
